subject.title: refactor(zalouser): share offset-preserving text chunk ranges

question: After resolving the dirty merge state, should `chunkTextRanges` and its two range-option types become the permanent public `plugin-sdk/text-chunking` contract?
rationale: This additive API is compatibility-sensitive and the protected maintainer routing requires explicit ownership of its long-term semantics, even though the current implementation and proof appear sound.

options.title: Land the shared API
options.body: Resolve conflicts, preserve the reviewed semantics, and approve the public API after exact-head SDK and Zalouser validation passes.

options.title: Keep the helper internal
options.body: Retain shared implementation internally but avoid exporting a permanent plugin SDK contract until a broader external use case is established.

recommendation.title: Land the shared API
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts, preserve the reviewed semantics, and approve the public API after exact-head SDK and Zalouser validation passes.
